patches_modified.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches_modified.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Each has its own switch, and both start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and can hide the Thoughts bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_modified.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Keep a streak going
patches_modified.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches_modified.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the app language
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, open LIVE panels dark in dark mode, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Lift text length limits
patches_modified.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Limit background traffic
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Location access governor
patches_modified.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Look like the store app
patches_modified.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Mute feed videos
patches_modified.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Network request report
patches_modified.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Not interested button
patches_modified.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's camera, editing and effects files, saving about 38 MB of storage. The catch: the Create tab and every recording, editing and effects tool stop working, and opening one, like effect search, can close TikTok. Leave it out if you make videos.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. A seek bar for video stories is there too.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Device privacy guard
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches_added.name: Filter feed
patches_added.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Keep Home feed
patches_added.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Show posted date
patches_added.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without the label still show. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches_modified.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_modified.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Long-press download
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button to the round menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, so you can save a pin without opening it. Slide onto the button and let go. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: No screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Open links in your browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Original-quality images
patches_modified.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Quiet email reminders
patches_modified.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: System share sheet
patches_modified.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_added.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches_added.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Open comments at full height

patches_added.name: Stop on bot detection
patches_added.description: Shows PTT's message and stops when its DDoS/BOT detection turns the connection away, instead of showing it as garbled text and reconnecting into it every few seconds.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play license check
patches_modified.description: Disables the Play Store license check, which a patched app always fails and which closes the app on launch. Needed by every patched build.

patches_modified.name: Fix article list loading
patches_modified.description: Drops the ANSI escape sequences JPTT's terminal emulator cannot parse, which otherwise swallow the screen content that follows them. Fixes the article list being stuck at 載入中, and keeps the next sequence PTT adds from breaking the app again.

patches_modified.name: Fix image links
patches_modified.description: Shows the picture for links an image host answers with a web page: an imgur album or .mp4, an address missing the i. subdomain, a meee.com.tw page. Only the preview and the full size image change, not the article text.

patches_modified.name: Fix photo upload in clones
patches_modified.description: Fixes taking a photo to upload when the Clone app patch has renamed the package. Changes nothing on a normal install.

patches_modified.name: Increase image cache size
patches_modified.description: Keeps the images of the article you are reading in memory, so they are not read again when you scroll back, and gives the memory back once the app has been in the background for a while. A disk cache behind it covers coming back after that.

patches_modified.name: More recent searches
patches_modified.description: Shows more of your recent search keywords in the article search dialog.

patches_modified.name: Patch settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a tab to JPTT's own settings where the options these patches add can be changed without patching the app again, and where every setting can be exported to a file and read back.

patches_modified.name: Play GIFs
patches_modified.description: Plays animated GIFs and WebPs in articles, which the app shows as their first frame. Needs Android 9 or later; the full size viewer still shows the first frame.

patches_modified.name: Preload article images
patches_modified.description: Downloads an article's images as soon as you open it instead of when you scroll to each one. Respects the app's own image loading settings.

patches_modified.name: Reconnect on return
patches_modified.description: Reconnects the moment you come back to the app, instead of leaving you on a countdown that grows to eight seconds. While an article is open it waits until you leave it or do something that needs PTT, so opening links does not log you in again every time.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the banner, the rows inside articles and lists, and the ad the app falls back to when it thinks AdMob is blocked. No ad is requested at all, so nothing is downloaded and nothing is reported.

patches_modified.name: Search history actions

patches_modified.name: Wrap recent searches

Only English comes with Gboard; with the switch on, Gboard's own downloader gets the other languages' dictionaries (word suggestions, autocorrect) through the network helper app (included), which for this can only reach Google's dictionary folder. patches_added.description: Puzzles from Lichess becomes the Puzzles tab's big button, with chess.com's Solve Puzzles above it. Lichess's puzzles play in chess.com's own puzzle screen (board, coach, sounds), rated on the phone the way Lichess rates them; nothing is sent to chess.com.

patches_added.name: Stockfish analysis
patches_added.description: Stockfish 19 on your phone, offline (arm64): best-move arrows on finished games, the analysis boards, the game explorer and Game Review (in a Lichess review, on the moves Lichess didn't mark), and an eval bar where chess.com has none of its own. patches_added.name: Unlimited Game Review

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches_modified.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Twitch Enhancement
patches_modified.description: Kizu Twitch enhancements for Twitch 31.3.1. v2.1 adds Hide Stream Extensions, third-party emote tap-to-preview, Danmaku comments, and a fast horizontal autocomplete strip for Twitch-native/7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes. Includes picker, catalog loading, deleted-message recovery and VOD-crash patch refinements.

patches_added.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST
patches_added.description: Requests the OpenXR BOOST performance hint for CPU and GPU on each session start. The runtime still controls clocks and thermal limits. Unsupported runtimes continue without BOOST. Adds an APK-local API layer; no root required. All repository-supported Steam Link builds; runtime performance benefit is not yet measured.

patches_added.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST (2.0.21/2.0.22)
patches_added.description: Asks OpenXR for the CPU and GPU BOOST hint at each session start; the headset still controls clocks and thermals, and unsupported ones continue without BOOST. No root needed; performance gain not yet measured. Details: https://github.com/4uva4ek/steamlink-patches.

patches_modified.name: Android XR native permission names
patches_modified.description: Swaps the app's built-in face and eye permission names to the ones Android XR needs. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Rewrites native Oculus face/eye permission checks to the Android XR names, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

patches_modified.name: Appear on top (legacy)
patches_modified.description: Legacy overlay fallback for older builds: lets Steam Link draw its panel over other screens.
patches_modified.previous_description: Legacy overlay fallback for older builds: adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and the compositor signal window.

patches_modified.name: Blue-noise dithering
patches_modified.description: Adds fine grain that hides harsh color steps, with separate on/off choices for the center and the background. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds static blue noise after video colour processing and fade, independently selectable on the foveal and the background/base layer; 8-bit or 10-bit input, always 8-bit sRGB output. Recommended on all exact bases with the foveal layer on by default. Turn OLED's VD-like fovea toggle off when foveal blue noise is used. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Renames the app so the patched Steam Link can install next to the original. Builds: 5001712 to 5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Renames the package and Steam Link's internal VR-launch component, so the patched app can be installed next to the original.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Sets the headset name SteamVR sees, with Meta Quest Pro as the recommended profile. Builds: 5001712 to 5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended: Meta Quest Pro on the legacy targets through 5002244. Explicit profiles override that.

patches_modified.name: Device identity (2.0.23/5002363)
patches_modified.description: Sets the headset name SteamVR sees; optional, so it stays out of the recommended set. Builds: exact 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR for exact 2.0.23/5002363. Optional; not part of the recommended set. Explicit profiles override that.

patches_modified.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches_modified.description: Removes 2 headset startup checks so tracking starts even when the app's own checks would stop it. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses the 2 capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

patches_modified.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches_modified.description: Skips a lobby permission check so the room screen loads normally. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses the permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates
patches_modified.description: Removes 3 XR checks on the streaming path so video can start. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244.
patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses the 3 XR gates in the stream path, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

patches_modified.name: GXR face and tongue bridge
patches_modified.description: Face and tongue feed for the VRCFT module: the face bridge on 5001712/5001812/5001968/5002244, tongue out/left/right/up/down slots on 2.0.23/5002363; Valve's own expressions and tongue-out keep working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the Galaxy XR face transport for the VRCFT module, per exact build: the face-tracking bridge layer (XR_FB_face_tracking2 to XR_ANDROID_face_tracking) and the FACE_TRACKING permission on the legacy targets 5001712/5001812/5001968/5002244; the tongue out/left/right/up/down transport slots (keeping Valve's native face expressions and standard TongueOut) on 2.0.23/5002363.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR SteamVR driver (galaxyxr)
patches_modified.description: Sets Galaxy XR headset and controller names in SteamVR, replacing the Meta Quest Pro spoof. Builds: 5001712 to 5002363. Needs: Galaxy XR VRLink Setup on the PC, or controllers show no model.
patches_modified.previous_description: Reports the headset and controllers to SteamVR through the resource-only `galaxyxr` driver installed by Galaxy XR VRLink Setup on the PC: Galaxy XR identity, {galaxyxr} icons, input profiles and controller models, and the calibrated grip offset. Replaces the Meta Quest Pro spoof; the PC driver must be installed or the controllers show no model. Controllers keep the oculus_touch type because vrlink accepts no other.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free high-resolution fix: adds a small Android-surface trigger and leaves the renderer's own formats, including future RGB10_A2, untouched. No image copy. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Permission-free high-resolution fix: appends a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger and leaves each build's native projection layers and formats, including future RGB10_A2, untouched. No image copy. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363.

patches_modified.name: Microphone input preset
patches_modified.description: Switches the microphone's capture mode; Voice Recognition tested clearest and loudest on Galaxy XR. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Selects Steam Link's AAudio microphone processing mode. On Galaxy XR, Voice Recognition was clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.

patches_modified.name: Network Optimizations
patches_modified.description: Keeps streaming smooth after Wi-Fi hiccups: lost packets are re-requested, recent video frames are kept, and bigger buffers absorb bursts; headset verification still pending. Builds: 2.0.23/5002363 only.
patches_modified.previous_description: Improves Steam Link 2.0.23's streaming transport: a loss burst large enough to overflow the retransmission-request buffer now re-requests the accumulated missing packets instead of aborting the stream, the frame-reorder (backtrack) window widens from 6 to 12 frames, a momentarily-starving decoder keeps its buffered frames instead of flushing them, and the UDP send buffer for retransmission requests grows from 128 KiB to 1 MiB. No bitrate, resolution or quality setting is changed. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset validation pending.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Tunes the OLED headset's color with gamma and saturation presets, plus optional center-of-view tweaks; visible improvement needs headset verification. Builds: 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Applies OLED gamma/saturation calibration with 8-bit sRGB output, plus optional VD-like SDR foveal processing and a separate foveal gamma. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363; visible improvement needs headset verification.

patches_modified.previous_description: Requests hand, eye, face, microphone and Bluetooth permissions at startup on older builds. Battery settings and the splash are separate patches.

patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Launching Steam Link splash and unmanaged VRLink startup on older builds. Requests no permissions; pick Startup permission requests for those.

patches_modified.name: Visual Delay Fix
patches_modified.description: Re-times the headset's position report so head movement shows up sooner; controller movement is untouched. Builds: 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968, 2.0.22/5002244, 2.0.23/5002363.
patches_modified.previous_description: Offsets the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes the exported HMD velocity fields, so head tracking leads the rendered frame. Controllers are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: XR Core Runtime
patches_modified.description: Installs the bridge files the other XR patches need.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the XR runtime bridge resources and extension DEX that the other XR patches need.

patches_modified.name: XR Device Config Baseline
patches_modified.description: Installs the default Galaxy XR headset and controller settings plus the dashboard files.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs baseline Galaxy XR HMD, controller and default config payloads plus the dashboard bootstrap assets.

patches_modified.name: XR Input Routing Config
patches_modified.description: Installs the settings file that routes pointer and button input to the launcher UI.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs ui_config.json so XR pointer and button input reaches the launcher UI.

patches_modified.name: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Switches 4XVR video playback to 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Routes the AAudio calls of Vr4pMediaPlayer and its audio runnable through the bundled 5.1-channel bridge, initializes the bridge in Main4XActivity and refreshes the subtitle style on the playback-speed tick for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Audio bridge payload (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Adds the bundled sound engine that lets 4XVR play 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the bundled 5.1-channel AAudio bridge native for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Syncs scene changes and screen updates to the display's frame rhythm, keeping playback smooth. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Drains the render dispatch queue before every frame, hands scene switches to RenderDispatch.requestScene instead of the retired render runnable, and routes window teardown through the dispatch for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Replaces the Quest 3 controller artwork and shapes with the Galaxy XR controller models. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Replaces the four Quest 3 controller assets with the Galaxy XR reference models (2048x2048 textures, re-authored meshes) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Static asset swap; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Installs the standard XR files 4XVR needs to start on Galaxy XR instead of closing right after opening. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the Khronos OpenXR loader 1.1.58, the 4XVR view-config API layer and the Galaxy XR manifest declarations (OpenXR 1.1, passthrough, hand and eye input) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Decoded-base adaptation; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Restores the proper 4XVR icon on the device's app launcher and in the patch manager. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Re-exposes the stock 4XVR launcher artwork under the canonical ic_launcher/ic_launcher_round names (adaptive icon plus density PNGs) and points the manifest at them, matching the Steam Link icon shape for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Runs 4XVR's picture at Galaxy XR's native 72 Hz rate instead of 60 Hz. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Clamps the InitializeDevice refresh-rate picker floors (121.0f/91.0f -> 73.0f) so exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022 requests Galaxy XR's 72 Hz mode. Three guarded bytes in libvr4p-oculus.so; runtime application pending headset validation. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Adds the HDR video component and its open-source notices; built on libplacebo (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the modified libplacebo 7.360.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later), the 4XVR HDR bridge native and the bundled open-source notices for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Keeps the Meta store calls out of the way, so 4XVR starts instead of hanging on its splash screen. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stubs the 11 exported Oculus platform-init/entitlement/message functions in libovrplatformloader.so of exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. The reference Galaxy XR build requires the Meta platform channel to stay inert on a non-Meta runtime: without these stubs the app hangs on the splash — the OpenXR session is created but never presents its first frame (Galaxy XR on-device A/B, 2026-10-12). Meta-store VIP flows degrade. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Re-checks the first-launch prompts after you return from system settings. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Re-checks the 4XVR startup popups after the activity resumes or returns from system settings: hides the All-files-access prompt once external storage access is granted (the stock flow never re-checks the result of its 0x59E2 request) and hides the release-notes window when its saved version already covers the installed build, for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium playback without a store check on Galaxy XR, where the store cannot be reached. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the 4XVR premium gate on Galaxy XR, where the Meta Store cannot be reached to verify a purchase: every start forces the app's own VIP state on through ChangeCurVIPStateClear(true), the same state transition a store purchase applies, so IsMP() is true and the trial playback limiter stays off. The dead Meta-store Buy entry points re-assert the unlocked state instead of calling the native checkout; the Buy buttons are hidden in favor of the Sync slot. Exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Render dispatch payload (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Adds the scene-timing engine that keeps 4XVR visuals and screens in step with the frames. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the 4XVR render dispatch native (frame-synced scene queue and adaptive theater background updates) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Keeps the startup greeting and on-screen notifications working when the app rebuilds its display. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Registers the bundled GxrToastContinuity helper, whose I610UEU2AZF3-gated memory-buildup fix and toast continuity keep the Galaxy XR UI pipeline warm across activity recreation, right after Main4XActivity.onCreate for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headless validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle suite (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Moves subtitles around, enlarges the subtitle panel and loads your own subtitle font. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the subtitle position controls row, the enlarged subtitle panel height, immediate config persistence on color-tab changes, the custom subtitle font load and the wrapped-cue size clamp for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. patches_modified.name: Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: Adds the subtitle engine used by the 4XVR subtitle controls. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs the subtitle position native library used by the 4XVR subtitle suite controls on exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches_modified.name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)
patches_modified.description: HDR videos play with their full colors and brightness. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
