patches_added.name: Remove Update Prompt
patches_added.description: Removes byAir's forced-update screen ("Pack up for Update! 🚀" / "Update Now") by pinning its version gate to "no update required". byAir fetches a server-side minimum version code on launch and, if your build is older, blocks the whole app behind a non-dismissible screen whose only action opens Google Play. With the gate closed a patched older build keeps running and never calls the min-version endpoint, so you no longer have to re-patch every time byAir ships a release.

patches_modified.name: Enable Online Pro
patches_modified.description: Experimental companion patch that keeps byAir's online Pro gates open without forcing the crash-prone global entitlement refresh path.

patches_modified.name: Enable Pro
patches_modified.description: Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, local user gating, and the notifications preferences "All" gate.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_modified.name: Block Ad Server
patches_modified.description: Stops Nepali Patro's ads. Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch in the ad-queue callback is retargeted so the full-screen page is never pushed; showHtmlInterstitialAdDialog - the single function that raises the HTML interstitial roadblock - is stubbed out; the popup/popup_html branch is forced down the app's own 'blocked' return; and the five raster formats (slider, banner, popup, card_view, circular) are dropped to the build's own empty-widget tail, so the image creatives Remove Ads cannot see - they are fetched by Dart through CachedNetworkImage, not by a WebView - are never requested at all. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to present the shell at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the HTML creatives and the AdMob interstitials.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches_modified.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches_modified.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_modified.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_modified.name: Change sticker size
patches_modified.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. On Telegram Beta it also turns off Firebase's crash and session reports from the next start. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable call debug upload
patches_modified.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable draft link previews
patches_modified.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to archive
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches_modified.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Disable update checks
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Exact numbers
patches_modified.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Folders by chat type
patches_modified.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches_modified.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide Send as button
patches_modified.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories
patches_modified.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches_modified.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches_modified.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches_modified.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches_modified.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off beta debug logs
patches_modified.description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_removed.name: Turn off beta debug logs
patches_removed.description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional banners
patches_modified.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide recommendations
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches_modified.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches_modified.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide time on stickers
patches_modified.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Hide translate bar
patches_modified.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches_modified.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

patches_modified.name: HushTelegram settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches_modified.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches_modified.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Message times with seconds
patches_modified.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches_modified.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Reveal spoilers
patches_modified.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Save downloaded files
patches_modified.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches_modified.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches_modified.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches_modified.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches_modified.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Turn off beta debug logs
patches_modified.description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches_modified.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Use normal paste
patches_modified.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches_modified.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

patches_modified.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches_modified.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches_modified.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches_modified.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable Firebase Crashlytics
patches_modified.description: Adds the official firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled=false manifest flag, disabling all crash/log reporting to Firebase Crashlytics at SDK init.

patches_modified.name: Disable Pairip license check
patches_modified.description: Prevents the Pairip-injected Application class from binding to the Play Store licensing service, which would otherwise redirect to / force-close for a side-loaded APK.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Integrity failure crash
patches_modified.description: Prevents SecurityException when the Play Integrity API call itself fails (APP_NOT_INSTALLED / APP_UID_MISMATCH), as happens for side-loaded APKs.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Integrity gating flag wait
patches_modified.description: Stops the startup coroutine from waiting forever on a Remote-Config-backed flag to decide whether to run the Play Integrity flow, by always treating it as disabled.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Integrity token request
patches_modified.description: Makes the Play Integrity token request always fail immediately with an unclassified exception, so the app treats it as gracefully unavailable and continues initialization instead of getting stuck on a Play-Store-required gate.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Integrity verdict validation
patches_modified.description: Removes client-side SecurityException throws that reject unlicensed/unattested/unrecognized Play Integrity verdicts, without touching unrelated code sharing the same method.

patches_modified.name: Disable StoreLogs telemetry
patches_modified.description: Prevents the app from uploading queued client-side log entries to its own backend telemetry endpoint (.../Log/StoreLogs).

patches_modified.name: Disable broadcast receiver security check
patches_modified.description: Removes SecurityException throws gating a BroadcastReceiver's onReceive, which fail when the broadcast sender isn't verified as the real Play Store.

patches_modified.name: Disable certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Prevents the app's OkHttp CertificatePinner from ever being installed, allowing HTTPS traffic to be intercepted (e.g. by a proxy) for analysis.

patches_modified.name: Trust user-installed certificates
patches_modified.description: Adds a user certificate trust anchor to the network security config, so a MITM proxy's installed CA is accepted (this is separate from and in addition to disabling OkHttp's code-level certificate pinning).

patches_modified.name: All-In-One
patches_modified.description: Enables video playback and downloads, removes ads and upsell prompts, bypasses the region block, and unlocks the hidden Laboratory menu. Requires Android 10 or later.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium servers and removes ads, upgrade banners, the launch paywall and the Android TV sign-in screen.

patches_added.name: Hide layout components
patches_added.description: Adds settings to hide the Help center, Spread the word and About sections.

patches_added.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_added.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_added.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read button
patches_added.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_removed.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over or keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. Another gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon and the logo at the top of Home match your pick. The normal blue icon keeps Facebook's wordmark. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, open LIVE panels dark in dark mode, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA; turn it off if you don't use an HTTPS-filtering proxy.

patches_modified.name: Skip ads
patches_modified.description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by emptying the LuraPlayer ad-break schedule — both the client-side VMAP breaks (third-party ads) and the first-party house / cross-promo breaks — so no ad-periods are inserted into the timeline, and by preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.
patches_modified.previous_description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by stopping the LuraPlayer linear ad-break scheduler (client-side VAST) and preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.

patches_added.name: Background Slimmer
patches_added.description: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.

patches_added.name: MLKit Vision Slimmer
patches_added.description: Disables machine learning vision components to reduce binary overhead (breaks QR and barcode scanning).

patches_removed.name: X Background Slimmer
patches_removed.description: Disables background WorkManager services, home screen widgets, and Cast/NFC companion services to reduce background resource consumption.

patches_removed.name: X MLKit Vision Slimmer
patches_removed.description: Disables MLKit component discovery and registrars. WARNING: this breaks in-app QR and barcode scanning.

patches_modified.description: Blocks tracking services, analytics collection, and advertising identifiers.

patches_modified.name: Block cookie notice

patches_added.name: Anonymous chat
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_added.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_added.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_added.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_added.name: Background audio
patches_added.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_added.name: Block display ads
patches_added.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_added.name: Chat appearance
patches_added.description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat keywords
patches_added.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat overlay
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_added.name: Chat timestamps
patches_added.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Default startup tab
patches_added.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_added.name: Fix notifications
patches_added.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_added.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_added.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_added.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_added.name: Hide Home sections
patches_added.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_added.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_added.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_added.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Hide player buttons
patches_added.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_added.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_added.name: Navigation bar position
patches_added.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Normal latency
patches_added.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Player gestures
patches_added.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_added.name: Playlist proxy
patches_added.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_added.name: Refresh stream
patches_added.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_added.name: Show video stats
patches_added.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_added.name: Tablet layout
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_added.name: Third-party badges
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_added.name: Third-party emotes
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_added.name: Use native player
patches_added.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_added.name: VOD chapters
patches_added.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_added.name: Watch without signing in
patches_added.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

patches_modified.name: Hide upgrade promotions

patches_added.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches_added.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Native Bubbles needs Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_modified.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. When you share one into Messenger from another app, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox ads
patches_modified.description: Hides ad cards in your chat list. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, so this is only a safeguard in case they come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Raises Messenger's limit of three pinned chats to 20, so you can keep more chats at the top of your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo as the original image instead of Messenger's recompressed copy, so it stays sharper. Photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger 582 sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_modified.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop nearby scans
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_modified.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use your own font
patches_modified.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Only One Free Store
patches_modified.description: Makes 'Restore Purchases' grant every store item for free (Ultimate Power, all classes, bundles and powers) — also removes ads.

patches_modified.name: Only One IAP billing bypass
patches_modified.description: Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.

patches_modified.name: Only One PairIP removal
patches_modified.description: Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.

patches_modified.name: All items owned
patches_modified.description: Every gun, skin, glove and drone shows as unlocked, and you can equip any of them. Your save file is not changed.

patches_modified.name: Instant rewarded video
patches_modified.description: Reward buttons pay out instantly. Tap once and you get the reward, with no ad to watch.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited currency
patches_modified.description: Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.

patches_added.description: Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on the device and the connected cloud instead of the Swift Backup server.
