patches_modified.name: Disable layout updates
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI.

patches_modified.name: Disable player popup panels
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically.

patches_modified.name: Disable playlist autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video.

patches_modified.name: Disable rolling number animations
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable rolling number animations of video view count, user likes, and upload time.

patches_modified.name: Disable scrolling speed limit
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled.

patches_modified.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network.

patches_modified.name: Disable video codecs
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.

patches_modified.name: Double tap to seek
patches_modified.description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Exit fullscreen mode
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end.

patches_modified.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches_modified.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide info cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Hide related video overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Hide related videos
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide status bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.

patches_modified.name: Hide timestamp
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches_modified.name: Loop video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches_modified.name: Mute button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches_modified.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback buffer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Player icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_modified.name: App icon
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Show view count
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_modified.name: Start as guest
patches_modified.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_modified.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.description: Overrides the feed flyout 'Play next in queue' with the Morphe video queue.

patches_modified.name: Ambient mode
patches_modified.description: Adds options to bypass power saving restrictions for Ambient mode and disable it entirely or in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: App refresh rate

patches_modified.name: Bypass image region restrictions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.

patches_modified.name: Bypass link redirects
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly.

patches_modified.name: Captions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled or to set caption cookies.

patches_modified.name: Cat lock
patches_modified.description: Adds a cat button to the video player that locks the screen so a pet can watch without accidentally swiping the video away; unlock by quickly tapping alternating opposite sides of the screen.

patches_modified.name: Change form factor
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device.

patches_modified.name: Change header
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

patches_modified.name: Change start page
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches_modified.name: Channel search
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube.

patches_modified.name: Channel whitelist
patches_modified.description: Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds.

patches_modified.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches_modified.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches_modified.name: Copy video link
patches_modified.description: Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. For mounted (root) installations the branding is applied while patching, because it cannot be changed from the app settings.

patches_modified.name: Custom player overlay opacity
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the opacity of the video player background when player controls are visible.

patches_modified.name: DeArrow
patches_modified.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API, or replace video thumbnails with image captures from the video.

patches_modified.name: Disable DRC audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches_modified.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches_modified.name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop feeds from refreshing automatically after they become outdated.

patches_modified.name: Disable double tap actions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable player double tap gestures.

patches_modified.name: Disable fullscreen gestures
patches_modified.description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom.

patches_modified.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions.

patches_modified.name: Disable layout updates
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI.

patches_modified.name: Disable player popup panels
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically.

patches_modified.name: Disable playlist autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video.

patches_modified.name: Disable rolling number animations
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable rolling number animations of video view count, user likes, and upload time.

patches_modified.name: Disable scrolling speed limit
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled.

patches_modified.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network.

patches_modified.name: Disable video codecs
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.

patches_modified.name: Double tap to seek
patches_modified.description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches_modified.name: Exit fullscreen mode
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end.

patches_modified.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices.

patches_modified.name: Force original audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches_modified.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches_modified.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches_modified.name: Hide Shorts components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide info cards
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide layout components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches_modified.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches_modified.name: Hide related video overlay
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches_modified.name: Hide related videos
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide status bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.

patches_modified.name: Hide timestamp
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches_modified.name: Hide video action buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches_modified.name: Loop video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Media notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches_modified.name: Miniplayer
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches_modified.name: Mute button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches_modified.name: Navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches_modified.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches_modified.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches_modified.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches_modified.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches_modified.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Play all
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Playback buffer
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches_modified.name: Playback in feeds
patches_modified.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Player icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

patches_modified.name: PoToken provider
patches_modified.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches_modified.name: Reload video
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_modified.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches_modified.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: Restore original titles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches_modified.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches_modified.name: Save to Watch later
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches_modified.name: Settings menu filter
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches_modified.name: Shorts autoplay
patches_modified.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches_modified.name: Shorts icon style
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

patches_modified.name: Skip silence
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches_modified.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches_modified.name: Spoof video streams
patches_modified.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches_modified.name: Swipe controls
patches_modified.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

patches_modified.name: Video quality
patches_modified.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches_modified.name: Voice over translation
patches_modified.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_modified.name: App icon
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: NSFW mode
patches_modified.description: Adds an NSFW row to the navigation drawer that reduces the home feed to its 18+ posts. Turned off until it is switched on. Reddit only sends 18+ posts to accounts that have 'Show NSFW content' enabled, so the feed is empty without that account setting.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Show view count
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_modified.name: Start as guest
patches_modified.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_added.name: Folders by chat type
patches_added.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Save downloaded files
patches_added.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_added.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the app icon, on Android 13 and up. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_added.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_added.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Back leaves Home
patches_added.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_added.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_added.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches_added.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_added.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_added.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_added.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Long press to zoom
patches_added.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_added.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_added.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_added.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches_added.description: Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_added.name: Rounded post corners
patches_added.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Show when someone was last active
patches_added.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster, and a download icon beside Save under each post. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Search, Create and Profile, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search button and a Ghost mode button to it, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.description: Bypasses client-side audio bitrate export caps (enabling 320kbps MP3 and WAV export options) and unlocks unlimited audio pitch shift, tempo changes, Smart Metronome, and chord detection in Moises (v2.7.2 recommandée).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium & Pro Features - Moises
patches_modified.description: Hooks Google Play BillingClient, RevenueCat EntitlementInfo, and subscription data models in Moises (v2.72.0 recommandée) to unlock client-side Pro features, bypass startup upgrade paywalls, Smart Metronome, chord detection, and pitch/speed controls.

patches_added.name: Speed cameras
patches_added.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server.

patches_added.name: Speeding chime
patches_added.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet.

patches_added.name: All moods
patches_added.description: Every mood can be chosen: the ones Waze keeps for higher ranks and the beta moods it hides.

patches_added.name: No AI reporting
patches_added.description: Turns off conversational reporting, Waze's Gemini voice assistant for reports, together with its activation dialog, tips and onboarding.

patches_added.name: No Google Assistant
patches_added.description: Keeps Google Assistant out of Waze: no Assistant button, onboarding or settings entry, whatever Waze's server enables for your region.

patches_added.name: Report speed limit
patches_added.description: Turns on Waze's own switch for correcting the speed limit from the speedometer, the old mods' "Report speed limit". Waze's server keeps it off; what it shows is not verified here.

patches_modified.name: Alert distances
patches_modified.description: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them.

patches_modified.name: Full black
patches_modified.description: Waze's dark mode in true black for AMOLED screens: the app's dark backgrounds are black, and with Black night map the night map's background too. Roads, labels, buttons and text keep their colours.
patches_modified.previous_description: Waze's dark mode in true black for AMOLED screens: the night map's background and the app's dark backgrounds are black. Roads, labels, buttons and text keep their colours.

patches_modified.name: Map skin
patches_modified.description: The old Waze mods' map skin, as changes to Waze's own: bigger map labels, a wider navigation arrow head and a warm day background. The night background is Full black's. Skipped by Morphe Manager 1.35 and other patcher 1.15+ builds, which would crash Waze when the map opens; patch with Morphe Desktop to get it.
patches_modified.previous_description: The old Waze mods' map skin, as changes to Waze's own: bigger map labels, a wider navigation arrow head and a warm day background. The night background is Full black's.

patches_modified.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder
patches_modified.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate
patches_modified.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes
patches_modified.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag
patches_modified.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Import/Export login token
patches_modified.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches_modified.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches_modified.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches_modified.name: Native translator
patches_modified.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads

patches_added.name: Auto reply
patches_added.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_added.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. When you share one into Messenger from another app, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_added.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_added.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_added.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_added.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Use your own font
patches_added.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Native Bubbles needs Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat Heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab, menu entries and AI in search. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox ads
patches_modified.description: Hides ad cards in your chat list. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, so this is only a safeguard in case they come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Messenger from telling people you read their message. Encrypted chats you open can stay unread on this phone. Replying or switching this off may notify the sender. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, so you can open these settings from inside Messenger. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo as the original image instead of Messenger's recompressed copy, so it stays sharper. Photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.description: Stop uploading your call history to Truecaller's servers, and stop it reading the system call log to do so.

patches_added.name: Stop call history sync
patches_added.description: Stop uploading your call history to Truecaller's servers, and stop it reading the system call log to do so.

patches_added.name: Black theme
patches_added.description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.

patches_added.name: Customization screen
patches_added.description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches_added.name: Zoom controls in navigation
patches_added.description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.

patches_modified.name: Remove telemetry
patches_modified.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services.
patches_modified.previous_description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.

patches_added.name: Add microG support
patches_added.description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.

patches_added.name: Black theme
patches_added.description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.

patches_added.name: Bypass Play Services checks
patches_added.description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.

patches_added.name: Customization screen
patches_added.description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.

patches_added.name: Location provider toggle
patches_added.description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG's (microg Services) or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches_added.name: Remove permissions
patches_added.description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.

patches_added.name: Remove telemetry
patches_added.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services.

patches_added.name: Zoom controls in navigation
patches_added.description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.

patches_added.name: Elevate right navigation buttons
patches_added.description: Elevates the right-side navigation buttons (Search, Sound, Report, Media) above the media player and bottom panel during turn-by-turn navigation in portrait mode.

patches_added.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_added.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_added.name: Keep the app language
patches_added.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.
patches_modified.previous_description: Replaces TikTok's dark background palette with black or a chosen color. The light theme keeps its colors. It rewrites TikTok's resources, so patching with it on is slower when the manager's memory limit is low. Give the manager 768 MB or more. At 640 MB it still finishes, just more slowly.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, and hold a profile picture or story to save it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds download quality choices, original Photo Mode images, separate audio files and optional video details. A photo post can also save as one video with its sound and no TikTok logo. It can check for an existing saved video before downloading another copy, and mark the videos it saved on profile grids. Long presses can save profile pictures and stories. Nothing changes until you turn an option on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Ignores the creator's Duet and Stitch setting so the entries appear for videos that closed them. Everything else the app checks still applies: a photo post, a private video or one with music it may not reuse is still refused, and whether the upload is accepted is the server's decision, not the app's. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches_modified.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes TikTok's secure flag off its windows, so screenshots and screen recordings aren't black, and turns off its Circle to Search block. Off until you turn it on. Restart TikTok after changing it. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Always shows the publish date in video author information, and can show it to the second or on profile grids. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Always upload in HD
patches_modified.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes TikTok treat its own HD upload choice as on for every video you post, as if you'd turned it on yourself on the post page. A clip TikTok doesn't count as high quality posts as before. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: App lock
patches_modified.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Puts TikTok behind your phone's screen lock, so a fingerprint, face or PIN lets you in. It asks when TikTok starts and when you come back after a time you pick, before anything shows. A link you open from another app still goes to its video after you confirm your identity, and TikTok's preview in recent apps stays blank while the lock is on. On a phone with no screen lock, TikTok opens as before and says why. Off until you turn it on. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
