patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Once you turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels, it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels, until you turn it off yourself.

patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: A story plays again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on.

patches_modified.name: Open developer options
patches_modified.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags (MetaConfig and quick experiments) can be looked at and overridden on your phone. A wrong flag can break parts of Instagram until you reset it there.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a web link you tap in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram and other Meta pages, and ads, still open in the app.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Instagram's dark mode uses pure black instead of its near-black gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus, sheets and buttons keep their own grays so they stay easy to see. Chosen when you patch, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build doesn't update on its own, so without this it would stop working after a few weeks.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped. The permissions for them are taken out of the build, so Google Play services hands Instagram a string of zeros in place of the ID.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty room Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there, on a phone that hides its navigation bar and in a pop-up window. A change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key open from Instagram too, and Instagram trusts them when they share to it or ask it for your sign-in. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.
patches_modified.previous_description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Takes stkn, igsh, utm_source and Instagram's other tracking keys off the links you copy or share, and opens a bio link without going through Instagram's click tracker. The post, reel, story or profile a link opens stays the same.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds an optional Save action to the common comment menu when a comment has a photo of its own. It saves the largest size Instagram sent, the same way Download saves a post's photo.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under its switch can show the time left before the story expires, or only the time it went up. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the date and time a story was posted in its header, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any, or as a chip under their counts that also says Following each other. A second switch, off to start, marks the accounts on your own Following list that don't follow you back.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any. A second switch, off to start, marks the accounts on your own Following list that don't follow you back.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow. Tap Following at the top to switch to For you, and Home remembers your pick. A second switch, off to start, takes For you out of Home. A change to either shows once Instagram restarts.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram from crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an x86 Chromebook or an emulator, by skipping the one code protection step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping until you've had a 15 minute break.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps a swipe in Reels from moving on to the next reel, and a pull down from loading new ones. The reel you opened still plays, and its buttons still work.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Instagram's timing.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Keeps a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button and every other way into the camera still work.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on the screen, or larger. Pick the size in HushGram's settings.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. Feed videos show a play button, the way they do when Instagram saves mobile data.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A switch for comments starts off. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Adds an off-by-default switch to hold back the opened receipt for view-once photos and videos in messages. Ordinary chat and voice receipts keep Instagram's behavior.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds story-view reports while its switch is on. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep showing as new. An optional Mark as seen button selects stories to send.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Lets screenshots and screen recordings work wherever Instagram blocks them, like disappearing photos and videos in your chats.

patches_added.name: Ask before a call
patches_added.description: Asks before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on a call button doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a like
patches_added.description: Asks before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't. Continue goes ahead and Cancel doesn't. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_added.description: Asks before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so a stray pull keeps what's on screen. Refresh goes ahead, and Cancel stops the spinner. Its switch, under Feed, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change the like animation
patches_added.description: Plays an animation you pick, from the ones Instagram made for Instagram Rings creators, in the heart that pops up when you double tap a post. Its switch, under Reels, starts off.

patches_added.name: Change version code
patches_added.description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Instagram's checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Once it's in, going back to an unpatched Instagram means uninstalling first, which deletes Instagram's data on your phone, and later HushGram builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.

patches_added.name: Clear the media cache
patches_added.description: Once Instagram's cache holds more than 500 MB of images and videos, deletes the images when it goes to the background and the videos the next time it starts. A Clear now row shows what it freed. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay.

patches_added.name: Data saver
patches_added.description: Loads photos at a smaller size and starts videos, reels and stories at the lowest quality, on mobile data or on every network. It works through Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it brings both along.

patches_added.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_added.description: Keeps Instagram from noticing your screenshots, so whoever sent you a disappearing photo or video isn't told you took one.

patches_added.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_added.description: Keeps what you open from search out of Recent, both in the app and on Instagram's side. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them.

patches_added.name: Download voice messages
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save to the menu you get by holding a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Full resolution photos
patches_added.description: Loads photos in your feed, in carousels and in posts you open at the largest size Instagram sends rather than the size it picks for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on a phone under 1440 pixels wide. It can use more data.

patches_added.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_added.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group per type with a second switch, so they don't fill the notification shade. A group of two or more shows how many it holds. Tapping a notification still opens what it did.

patches_added.name: Hide Instants
patches_added.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instagram is told your account doesn't have Instants, its no-edit camera for friends.

patches_added.name: Hide comments
patches_added.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off the posts in your feed, with a switch under Comments that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide that you're typing
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so the people you're chatting with don't see when you're typing. Unlike turning off the typing indicator in Instagram's settings, you still see when they're typing.

patches_added.name: Hide the Share button
patches_added.description: Takes the Share button and its count off the posts in your feed and off reels, with a switch under Sharing that starts off.

patches_added.name: Hide the home feed
patches_added.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows the stories row and nothing under it. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts.

patches_added.name: Keep in chat
patches_added.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats, as if they'd been sent with Keep in chat, so they don't disappear after you open them. Turning it on or off reaches the ones already loaded once the chat loads again.

patches_added.name: Lock your messages
patches_added.description: Adds switches that keep your inbox and chats, or all of Instagram, covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. They lock again when you leave Instagram or after the time you pick, and message notifications say only that a message came.

patches_added.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch so opening a chat doesn't tell people you've seen their messages. Unlike turning off read receipts in Instagram's settings, you still see when they've seen yours. Instagram's Mark as read still lets them know, whether you long press one chat or pick several. View-once photos and videos have their own patch.

patches_added.name: Save profile picture
patches_added.description: Adds an optional Save profile picture row to the menu on someone's profile. It saves their picture at the largest size Instagram has. Its switch starts off.

patches_added.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_added.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, under it in your feed, and the date and time of each comment, instead of how long ago. It follows your phone's language and 12 or 24-hour setting.

patches_added.name: Spoof location
patches_added.description: Tells Instagram the phone is at a place you set in HushGram's settings, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places.

patches_added.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_added.description: Keeps a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still changes tabs, and Reels still scroll up and down.

patches_added.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_added.description: Keeps HDR photos and reels from brightening the screen above everything else, with a switch under Playback that starts off.

patches_added.name: View live anonymously
patches_added.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. A live that ends can keep looking live until you leave it. Your own lives still count their viewers.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity with the comment preview, and the comment bar under a reposted reel. Each part has its own switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and friends' activity with the comment preview. Each part has its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds an optional Copy action to the common comment menu. Copies the original text with its line breaks.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark. Turn on Download cover for a row that saves the still picture shown before the reel plays.

patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Raised surfaces — buttons, cards, sheets and the Material You container ladder — can take their own surface color instead of one flat black, so the UI keeps an elevation step like Material 3. Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+; leaving that force off keeps the Material You roles and low-lStar selectors untouched. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_added.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_added.description: Pinterest and the ad and tracking code inside it read an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. A switch and Pause hand back the real ID.

patches_added.name: Hide save toasts
patches_added.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator. The pin is still saved.

patches_added.name: Original-quality images
patches_added.description: Has Pinterest's image model pick the original image before its large size wherever Pinterest supplied one. Uses more data.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads, AppsFlyer tracking, Bugsnag crash reports and the recommendations Pinterest publishes to Google Engage. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads and AppsFlyer tracking. A switch and Pause restore those runtime paths. Firebase Analytics is disabled in the manifest and stays disabled until you patch again without this patch. Sign-in, pin requests and Firebase push components are preserved.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Downloads a pin or selected visible grid pins using original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. The pin menu can also copy that media's link. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download pin to the pin menu for original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Saves in Downloads on Android 10 or newer, or asks for a save location on Android 9. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings at any time.

patches_modified.name: Change Zalo package name

patches_modified.description: Adds Zalo launch/provider checks and redirects Google Drive account selection and token binding to microG-RE (app.revanced / app.revanced.android.gms). Preserves the clone's actual caller identity; MicroG manifest metadata supplies the upstream Zalo identity.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on the pages Facebook blocks them on. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches_added.description: Games you play in Facebook get no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none to show, so a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on.

patches_added.name: Block screenshot detection
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats, games and everywhere else. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.

patches_added.name: Hide tabs
patches_added.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar: Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events. Each page stays in the Menu. Every switch starts off, and a change shows once Facebook restarts.

patches_added.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook uploading its app analytics in the background and skips its on-device learning jobs. Its switch starts on, under Privacy. Restart Facebook after changing it.

patches_added.name: Picture-in-picture
patches_added.description: A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook, through the picture-in-picture Facebook already has for Reels. Needs Android 12 or later.

patches_added.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches_added.description: Every seller's page in Marketplace gets View profile, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. Its switch starts on, under Marketplace.

patches_added.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches_added.description: Keeps HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness. They play at the same resolution, in the screen's usual range. Its switch starts on, under Playback.

patches_added.name: Turn off haptics
patches_added.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays on its own taps and gestures. The keyboard and your phone's own haptics stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches_added.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_added.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, its Menu and the screens that open over it at once, without the slide between them. Swiping and animations inside a page stay. Its switch starts on, under Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches_modified.description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI, a fourth takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds between posts, and a fifth removes posts featuring Meta's AI characters. The Meta AI cards switch starts on. The others start off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI. Every switch starts off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them, and a video ad that reaches the feed anyway isn't drawn. The listings people post stay.

patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Theme engine
patches_modified.description: Experimental recovery opt-in: runtime-selectable BlueIT themes applied to TikTok TUX/Compose colors and classic surfaces.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches_modified.name: Advanced feed filter
patches_modified.description: Adds BlueIT feed rules for promotional music, LIVE replays, and minimum like/view ratio.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Automatic clear display
patches_modified.description: Experimental recovery opt-in: automatically enters TikTok clear-display mode after a configurable delay for each newly played video.

patches_modified.name: BlueIT Service
patches_modified.description: Adds the BlueIT Service settings menu to supported TikTok builds.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the BlueIT Service settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.4.3.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit of up to 500 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local Java crash capture.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_modified.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches_modified.name: Download quality selector
patches_modified.description: Selects automatic, highest, or target video quality and lets BlueIT choose the preferred TikTok download stream.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable Live search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches_modified.description: Adds BlueIT Learn mode for recording newly observed TikTok configuration candidates while using a feature.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Gesture remapper
patches_modified.description: Remaps TikTok feed single tap, double tap, left/right seek, and long-press gestures.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Keeps a local BlueIT watch-history and filters videos you already watched from newly loaded feed batches.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Original Photo Mode downloader
patches_modified.description: Downloads the original Photo Mode CDN assets instead of keeping TikTok's rendered copies when enabled.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search. The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen, and another clears the close button, progress bar and pause and speed buttons Clear display leaves at the bottom. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the status bar.
